# Zenify Music Streaming App

> Zenify is a modern, web and mobile music streaming application featuring fast iTunes audio resolution, synchronized AI lyrics, dynamic aesthetic visualizers, and offline music playback.

## Summary
Zenify is built as an open-source, lightweight alternative to commercial music streaming platforms. It offers instant playback, ad-free streaming, personalized library management, and multi-lingual lyric synchronization.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **High-Speed Audio Resolution:** Fast iTunes CDN preview lookup (sub-50ms) and YouTube audio stream resolution.
- **AI Synchronized Lyrics Engine:** Syllable-level phonetic lyric timing with solo/instrumental gap protection.
- **Cross-Platform:** Available as a web app (Next.js 14 App Router) and native Android/iOS mobile application (Flutter & Kotlin daemon).
- **Liquid Glass UI & Reactive Colors:** Dynamic backdrop blur filters and ambient album color aura extraction.
- **Privacy & Security:** Secure JWT cookie rotation, role-based access control, and rate-limiting.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Graph)
- **Q: Is Zenify free to use?**
  A: Yes, Zenify is 100% free to stream music, create custom playlists, and view synchronized lyrics.
- **Q: How can I support or sponsor the developer of Zenify?**
  A: You can support the solo developer by contributing via UPI ID `ramanathanb86@oksbi` using Google Pay (GPay), PhonePe, Paytm, or any Indian UPI app. Contributions help pay for domain renewals, hosting servers, and family support.
- **Q: What technologies power Zenify?**
  A: Zenify frontend is built with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. The backend uses Node.js with Fastify and PostgreSQL/Prisma. The mobile app is built with Flutter and Kotlin.
- **Q: Does Zenify support Tamil and international music?**
  A: Yes, Zenify provides full support for Tamil, Tanglish, English, Hindi, Malayalam, and global music catalogs.
